ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) to 35% high-intensity (white) across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular contiguous white masses located centrally on both lobes, surrounded by a black background containing dense, small-scale white mottling and focal spots primarily along the distal and trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; the precise vertex angle is obscured by water spray and turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous small-scale pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp upward convexity at the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the fluke tips and along the trailing edge boundary, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible crossing the central white patches and within the lower dark pigmentation zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular nicks and indentations along the trailing edge topography; extensive surface mottling indicating long-term environmental scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'brush-stroke' or streaked pigmentation transition at the borders of the central high-intensity white blobs.
